recipes.oracle_text:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, discard a card.
Draw two cards.

recipe_coverage: Ordinary draw/discard pipelines through real spells, activations and creature entry/death. Oracle-pinned ordered operations distinguish costs from effects, recipients, fixed/discard-derived amounts and random subsets. Both controllers exercise exact costs, empty/short/uneven/duplicate hands, legal human choices, per-card hand/grave conservation, exact remaining libraries, source removal/re-entry, and caller-owned snapshots where applicable. Random distribution, alternate source abilities/costs, replacement/discard triggers, control changes and multiplayer remain component gaps.
